book.name: Lum
book.title: Ŋwa' wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ kentaashɛ ke Lum

content: Fo wee esaakè wee mvu kɛ
Ben efiisenè bonyii bo wɛɛyi yî mbee le ɛ̂ ben ɛnte. Fo ben ɛ boba bonyii ebeeke ɛ ɛ̀ nu mbew yî mwɛɛm mvù bó kpwawci lɛ ɛ̀ nu mvu lɛŋ keegee le kɛ.
Wee mvu nu ɛ wvú beŋe lɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ wen ediee fiɛɛ ficii. Geenɛn ɛ wee mvu wvù mbee we wɛɛyi nu ɛ wvú diee kɛ fiew ɛ ɛ̀ nu mbáse yì bó keeke lo.
Fo wee wvù diee fiɛɛ ficii yaa nyaake, enyɛnsè wee wvù nyaake kɛ. Fo wee wvù nyaake, esaakè wee wvù diee fiɛɛ ficii yaa nyaake mum sumtene lo nsaw we kɛ, njefo bó bocii nu ɛ Nyo' ɛ fiisɛn bó.

Ɛ̀ nu wo wvù yɛɛ keesaake wee lemme wee mvu mum sumtene lo nsaw we? Ɛ̀ kɛŋke cee ɛkolɛ we keeke eyɛn laa waa we lemme leeme ntay nuu wvú gbwee lo lɛ. Ɛ wvú nu ke eleem we, njefo Tata nulo eleke wvú we ɛ́ wvú eleem ntay.

Wee mvu nu tɛn dvú wvù joo lɛ ɛdiuw yomew nu yo baay baay ɛ̂ yomew e. Ɛ wee mvu joo fiew lɛ ɛdiuw ɛcii nu kɛ lɛŋlɛŋ. Fiɛɛ fì nu, nu kɛ lɛ fo wee ekɛŋkè kemaŋɛn ɛ̂ ŋkpwawcɛ we le yî fiɛɛ fì wvú leeme yî dvú le kɛ.

Wee wvù joo lɛ ɛdiuw yomew nu yo baay baay gee nonɛn keenya n'wvum ɛ̂ Tata. Ɛ wee wvù diee fiɛɛ ficii diee tɛn keenya n'wvum ɛ̂ Tata, no wvú gee nonɛn no nyaa keyoone ɛ̂ Nyo'. Ɛ wee wvú nyɛnsee keediee fiɛɛ ficii nyɛnsee kɛ tɛn keenya n'wvum ɛ̂ Tata, no wvú nyaa tɛn keyoone ɛ̂ Nyo'.
Beene ekeè lɛ ɛ́ wee nu dvú, tu kɛ ɛ̀ kɛŋke wvú ɛkolɛ kew kɛ. Ɛ́ wvú kpwe lo, ɛ́ saa ekɛŋke wvú ɛkolɛ kew kɛ.
Ɛ́ beene nu dvú, tu beene nu kɛ beene ɛ bo Tata, beene ɛ́ kpwe, tu beene nu kɛ beene ɛ bo Tata. Nonɛn, kɛnɛɛ beene nu dvú, kɛnɛɛ beene ɛ kpwe, tu ɛ̀ kɛŋke kɛ Tata beene.
Ɛ̀ nu shiee wvù Klistu to kpweɛ kase buy yî kpwe le no nu dvú. Wvú to ge nonɛn wvu lɛ wen enù Tata bonyii bocii bò bɛɛ dvú bô bò kpwekɛn wase.
Nonɛn, ɛ̀ nu nje la wvù wo saake waa bwoo mum sumtene lo nsaw we? Ɛ ɛ̀ nu tɛn nje la wvù wo nyɛnsee waa bwoo? Ben ekeè lɛ beene bocii nu ke eleem fwe dvu Nyo' ɛ́ wvú esaw beene.
Ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì bó nu ɛ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Me wvù Tata ŋgayte lɛ, no me nu dvú,
wee tfuu nu ke etum ɛnvuw ɛ̂ me ɛjise,
ɛ́ wee tfuu ejemyi bô diuw we lɛ me nu Nyo'.”

content: Fí ɛ mum ɛ no nu lɛ wee mwaaŋ mwaaŋ beene le kɛŋke keeke eleem ɛ̂ Nyo' ɛjise see no gee diew to nu.
Fo wee ege fiɛɛ fì waa bwee egbwe lo kɛ
Nonɛn, fo beene ebvuu esaake wee noo wee mum sumtene lo nsaw kɛ. Fiɛɛ fì beene kɛŋke keegeè nu lɛ wee dioo gee fiɛɛ no yɛne fo enu fiɛɛ fì ege ɛ́ waa bwee ebaytɛn yî dvú le kɛnɛɛ egbwe lo kɛ.

Me ŋkee naa lo, ɛ me ɛ mbee diɛwɛ wee Tata Jisos e lɛ kɛ fiɛɛ fidien fimew nu dvú ɛfinɛfin fì nu sɛ fí yuule lo kɛ. Geenɛn, ɛ́ wee mvu nɛ ɛ no yɛne lɛ fiɛɛ fidien fimew nu ɛ fí yaa yuule kɛ, tu fí nu enu kɛ nonɛn fô wvú le.
Ɛ́ wo diee fiɛɛ ɛ fí beete bô waa bwoo, tu kɛ wo bvuu duŋci keŋkoŋɛn fô wvú le kɛ. Fo wo ecinɛ ɛ́ fiɛɛ fì wo diee ege ɛ́ waa bwoo wvù Klistu to kpweɛ nje ye, egbwe lo kɛ.
Nonɛn, fo wo ege ɛ́ fiɛɛ fì jee fì wo gee ke enɛ etu fì bó ejemyi wase lɛ ɛ̀ nu fì befe kɛ.
Ben ekeè lɛ kɛ bvunfon bvu Nyo' le nu fiɛɛ fi ɛkumɛ mwɛɛm mvudien bô mwɛɛm mvuwuun kɛ. Ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fi ɛkumɛ keekɛŋke nce wvu teytey bô wvu nyɛkeey noo keekɛŋke nlaŋlaŋ wvù nɛn'yi fô Keyoy ke Yuule le.
Ɛ́ wee lemte Klistu le ɛ̂ yiyɛ je le, tu Nyo' nu eyuuke njoŋ bô wvú, ɛ bonyii bɛnsee tɛn wvú.
Beene emum ebiì mwɛɛm mvù too ɛ ɛ̀ nu bô nyɛkeey noo mvù fici beene keeyoote lo wee noo wee le.
Fo ben ebefe bô lemme di Nyo' le nje mwɛɛm mvudien kɛ. Ɛ̀ nu kecɛɛy lɛ mwɛɛm mvudien mvunciim yuule lo, geenɛn ɛ́ wo diee fiɛɛ fì nulo ege ɛ́ wee mvu egbwe lo, tu ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì befe ɛ wo gee.
Ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì jee keetun keedie nyam, kɛnɛɛ keewu mbvuum, kɛnɛɛ keege naa la fì nulo ege ɛ́ waa bwoo egbwe lo.

Ɛ́ fitele fiuw beŋe fiɛɛ fimew e, ɛ́ wo gɛɛ ɛ ɛ̀ no kee kɛ ben ɛ Nyo' bofɛɛ. Njoŋ wvu baay nu fô wee wvù shiee baa enu dvú fô wvú le keesaake ɛkolɛ kew kɛ, njefo wvú gee fiɛɛ fì wvú tomte lɛ fí nu lɛŋ e.

Geenɛn, wee wvù diee fiɛɛ kɛŋke kemaŋɛn fô fitele fiew e nu wase ŋgɛw e, njefo wvú gee fiɛɛ ɛ ɛ̀ yaa nu fì fitele fiew beŋe dvú kɛ. Ben ekeè lɛ fiɛɛ ficii fì wee gee sɛ fitele fiew nu ɛ bee, nu ɛ ɛ̀ nu kebefɛ.
